title: Debounce — trailing edge (Javascript)
description: Debounce waits until calls stop for `wait` ms, then runs once. The standard fix for search-as-you-type hammering a backend.
how_it_works: Each call clears the pending timer and starts a new one; only the last call in a burst survives the quiet period.
complexity: O(1). Tuning: profile before optimizing; the notes above name the usual bottleneck to measure first.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Leading-edge variants need a different shape; pick one and document it.
